_meta.scene: office_room.rad + materials.rad; 4x L09_neutral at (+/-1, +/-1.8, 2.9), down-pointing (electric_lights payload: ies+spd+placement)
_meta.note: FIRST end-to-end LIVE run of the electric integrated path (prior: emit-/mock-tested only; known gotchas ies2rad -o / ordered colorize / !xform). All three steps ran clean (no crash). run_grid/glare_ugr colorized the IES internally from the electric_lights payload (no separate colored_luminaire chaining needed). First live run, NOT an absolute-photometry baseline.

run_grid_electric.spatial_pattern: higher under/near the 4 fixtures (peaks ~45-46.5 lux), lower at the between-fixture edges/corners (~27-29 lux) -- see electric_photopic_lux_per_point (grid rows of 5, x=[1.4,0.7,0,-0.7,-1.4], y stepping -Y toward the window); pattern is internally consistent with 4 ceiling fixtures.
run_grid_electric.daylight_note: 0 because scene_sets has no sky source (run_grid adds none) -- same nuance as daylight_savings point_in_time; this run isolates the ELECTRIC contribution.
run_grid_electric.MAGNITUDE_FLAG: ~36 lux avg was ~14x too low. ROOT-CAUSED (see electric_source_cal_fix.json): NOT a batwing effect (L09 nadir candela ~1878 ~= peak) and NOT an hcl-mcp bug -- the local custom Radiance 6.1a build's compiled source_corr drops the ies2rad brightdata A1 (candela-scale) multiplier. FIXED via a source.cal patch: the same grid then reads avg 494 lux (min 363 / max 627), realistic and exactly 14.4x higher. hcl-mcp electric pipeline is correct given a Radiance whose source_corr honors A1. Shape + spectrum + wattage were correct throughout.

glare_ugr_electric.note: Render + evalglare ran end-to-end. DGP 0.16 = low glare (below the 0.35 perceptible threshold), plausible for ceiling panels out of the direct line of sight. UGR_FLAG: evalglare returned UGR=0 despite a listed glare source -- plausible (no UGR-relevant source at the Guth positions for this geometry) but worth a sanity check.

lighting_controls.note: Clean ContinuousOff dimming curve (full at 0 daylight -> off at >=iset). Fed a daylight SWEEP to exercise the range; the annual controls were already driven live with REAL daylight in Task 2 daylight_savings (8760 h).
